heading: EPFO Grievance: Resolve Claims, KYC, Balance Issues Online
tldr: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) provides an online grievance portal (EPFiGMS) for members to address various issues.
Common grievances include pending claim settlements, incorrect balance reflected in passbooks, and KYC update errors.
The online portal offers a structured way to register complaints, track their status, and receive resolutions from EPFO.
To file a grievance, you'll need your Universal Account Number (UAN) and details of the specific issue, along with any supporting documents.
Timely online grievance registration can significantly expedite the resolution of your EPFO-related concerns.
caption:
Ever wondered how to fix a problem with your PF money? If you're an Indian professional, your PF account is important for your future. Sometimes, there are issues like your balance being wrong or a claim not settling. Good news! The EPFO has an easy online way to complain and get help. It means you can sort out your PF problems faster from home. Learn how to use it in this article.
